steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Looks like you had a rough time as well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, what happened here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We were ambushed by Reunion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We were caught in a withering assault with no reinforcements. They easily routed our forces.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And Misha...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She was taken away by a woman dressed in red.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I really should have...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nevermind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, why is Misha so special?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you keep hiding things from us, it's only going to be harder and harder for us to continue working together.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have no obligation to tell you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Rhodes Island has an obligation to understand the objectives and prepare our strategies accordingly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Naturally, we'll continue to follow the L.G.D.'s instructions during our operations...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, when it comes to using the Infected to fight other Infected, we need all the information we can get.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: While you may have that information, you don't have the means of using it effectively to reduce your losses.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: On the other hand, we have the ability to stop Reunion, but we don't know what they're after.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You sounded a bit like that doctor just now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is, is that so...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is something that is equally important to both of us.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If it's because you need to ask for permission from Chief Wei...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When we investigated Misha, the most prominent bit of information was that her father was one of Chernobog's most influential people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha's father?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Naturally, we don't know how much Misha knows about Chernobog.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She could know nothing, or she could know everything.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nobody knows...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...except her.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We also have no idea what kind of information she might have.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Since you predicted that Lungmen would be Reunion's next target...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's obvious that we have to prevent Reunion from using Chernobog.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's why we can't allow them to have Misha.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We were aware of the fact that someone who fit her descriptions had taken refuge in Lungmen...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But until you actually found her, we weren't able to verify if that intel was accurate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If that's the case, we can't waste any more time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to stop Reunion and rescue Misha before they're able to take her back to Chernobog!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island, prepare to move out!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It was the L.G.D.'s responsibility to track her down.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...and letting Reunion capture her was a dereliction of our duties.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Rather than lauching a joint operation, we'll need Rhodes Island to eliminate other threats from Reunion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is an order.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't let me down.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: N-no! D-don't beat me...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You should've thought twice before entering Lungmen!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaaagh!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lock them all up!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They're not with this group of Infected. Curses...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not with this group either... Damn it all...

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: They... retreated way too quickly...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It seems that Reunion also has its own hierarchy.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They just left the riffraff behind to buy them more time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: To think that a single person could delay our reinforcements...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just who are they...

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam! We found some Reunion stragglers over there!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Follow me!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Be careful, Madam Ch'en!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: It's an ambush!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: G-go to hell!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't get in my way--!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, we're still on Lungmen soil!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: The nearby facilities can still be used, so please try not to cause too much damage!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Shut up already!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: At least, don't cut these buildings to pieces!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Th-this woman...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: She's so hard to deal with!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Hard to deal with?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Foolish Infected...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you think we'd allow you filth to treat Lungmen like your personal latrine?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: L.G.D., attack!
